# DECCAN II — Card List

**9 factions · 12 units each · 108 cards in the box.**

## The counter cycle

* **HORSE** beats **GUNS**
* **FOOT** beats **HORSE**
* **GUNS** beats **FOOT**

A countered unit loses its front whatever its strength. Otherwise the higher strength wins.

## The chassis

Every faction holds the **same twelve numbers** and **four units of each type**. The only
thing that differs between factions is which type each number is printed on.

> 1 · 2 · 3 · 4 · 4 · 5 · 5 · 6 · 6 · 7 · 8 · 9    (12 units, 60 strength, 4 of each type)

Factions are built from **archetypes**, each appearing in all three arms. The first group of
numbers goes to the faction's lead arm, the second to the next arm round the cycle, the third
to the last.

| Archetype | Lead arm | Next | Last |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| specialist | 6 · 7 · 8 · 9 | 2 · 4 · 5 · 6 | 1 · 3 · 4 · 5 |
| blindspot | 3 · 5 · 7 · 9 | 5 · 6 · 6 · 8 | 1 · 2 · 4 · 4 |
| champion | 2 · 7 · 8 · 9 | 4 · 4 · 5 · 5 | 1 · 3 · 6 · 6 |
